messages:
alana: Huge thanks to everyone who helped with the new-hire onboarding demo this morning. Saved a ton of nerves and several awkward silences. :relieved:
dez: special shoutout to @mira for the crisp walkthrough notes and the annotated screenshots. that made the handoff seamless. :raised_hands:
mira: happy to help! added the screenshots to the onboarding doc and a small checklist for the local env. snippet I added:
```md
- Verify local DB: `scripts/setup_local_db.sh --verify`
- Start dev server: `make dev`
- Open http://localhost:3000/onboarding-demo
```
tyler: ops and front desk also deserve kudos for setting up the meeting room and loaning the spare dongles. frontdesk-bot: [auto] Item logged: HDMI-dongle-07 loaned to Alana (expires EOD).
kudos-bot: [auto] New kudos: "mira & dez 	6 onboarding help" (from alana). See /kudos for details.
alana: also throwing $20 into the "thank-you snacks" jar and grabbing next week's coffee run. DM me if I missed anyone. :coffee:
dez: small idea 1: quick 'who helped' line in the weekly digest, 2: sticker vs pin for micro-kudos? votes? :ballot_box_with_check:
mira: sticker vote from me. easy to hand out, wearable.
tyler: pin is cute but stickers win for logistics.
alana: sticker it is. i'll order a 30-pack and stick them in the front desk basket. thanks again team 1 — felt really supported today. :tada:
